verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP hosts a dedicated first-party MCP server per app, so scanning or inspecting servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents any such scanning or vetting process. Encrypted credentials and a vague "security and observability" claim for Conduit are adjacent security features, not server inspection.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
